description:
Deploy a custom rule that fires on every future evaluate_output call of its bundle — persisted, active immediately, audited.

What it does. Stores the rule and loads it into the running engine. eval_type says WHEN it fires (that bundle, and eval_type="all"); severity says what a failure does: low and medium lower the score, high and critical fail the verdict. definition.type picks the check, definition.config its keys. A taken name is refused unless replace is true. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. For a one-off check (custom_rules on evaluate_output). To pause a rule (delete_rule with enabled: false).

Returns. JSON: rule, replaced, warning.

Errors. IRIS_DUPLICATE_RULE; IRIS_INVALID_RULE_CONFIG, naming the field; IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. list_rules — see what is deployed; delete_rule — remove or disable; evaluate_output — where it fires.

definition.description: The check: type, config and optional weight; an unknown key is rejected

config.description: Check configuration; required keys depend on type (regex_match: pattern; min_length: min_length; max_length: max_length; contains_keywords/excludes_keywords: keywords; cost_threshold: max_cost; json_schema: schema, optional; action_policy: allow and/or deny)

name.description: Ignored: the server overwrites it with the top-level `name`

type.description: Check type — decides which config keys are required

weight.description: Weight in the weighted score (default 1; must be > 0)

description.description: What this rule checks for and why it matters

evalType.description: camelCase alias of eval_type, accepted for compatibility — prefer eval_type (snake_case is canonical across the tools)

eval_type.description: The bundle this rule fires in (and on eval_type="all"); pass one of eval_type / evalType

name.description: Human-readable rule name (1-80 chars; used in eval results). Must be unique among deployed rules unless replace=true

replace.description: true replaces a deployed rule of the same name (fresh id, audit kept); false (default) refuses

severity.description: What a FAILURE of this rule means. low/medium: informational — contributes to the weighted score only (plus dashboard sort + audit alerts). high/critical: hard-fail — a failing evaluation of this rule forces the overall passed=false regardless of the weighted score

sourceMomentId.description: camelCase alias of source_moment_id, accepted for compatibility — prefer source_moment_id

source_moment_id.description: Optional id of the Decision Moment this rule came from; pass one of source_moment_id / sourceMomentId

name: deploy_rule
title: Deploy Custom Rule
